segments.normalizedSource: The following code shows an example of using [`vDSP_vsdiv`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accelerate/vdsp_vsdiv):
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let stride = vDSP_Stride(1)

var a: Float = 2
let b: [Float] = [1, 2, 4, 5]


let n = vDSP_Length(b.count)

var c = [Float](repeating: 0,
                count: b.count)

vDSP_svdiv(&a,
           b, stride,
           &c, stride,
           n)

// Prints "[2, 1, 0.5, 0.4]"
print(c)
```
